phase1_summary.note: Zero aggregate, effective-floor, firm-cohort, reallocation, crossover, or stacked 2025-rule candidates cleared Phase 1. Only four Tier 2 differential-bite specifications across two families (R2a post-2020 direct-grower bite and R4a 2011-2025 duration-amortization bite) advanced.

primary_hypotheses.estimand: Differential H-2A certified-hours elasticity per 1-SD within-region baseline (2008-2010) contract-duration wage-share exposure E_dur (reported per 1-SD and per 2-SD high-vs-low spread)
primary_hypotheses.sample: Ever-positive 2011-2025 counties in bite_county_year_panel.parquet with finite 2008-2010 H-2A baseline duration (1,615 active counties, 24,225 county-years, 85.7% of US H-2A hours)
primary_hypotheses.exposure_definition: s_wage = (aewr_0810 * 40 * mean_weeks_0810) / (aewr_0810 * 40 * mean_weeks_0810 + 2500), standardized within aewr_region_id to mean 0, SD 1 across baseline counties (E_dur)
matched_placebos: 2008-2010 event study on hours and positions (E_dur x year, ref=2010, joint CV3J F(3,16))

primary_hypotheses.estimand: Within-state-year differential H-2A certified-hours elasticity per 1-SD baseline contract-duration wage-share exposure E_dur (eliminating all state-year shocks)
matched_placebos: 2008-2010 event study under County + State x Year FE (hours and positions, joint CV3J F(3,16))

primary_hypotheses.estimand: Post-Addendum-B (2020-2025) direct-grower differential H-2A certified-hours elasticity per 1-SD within-region frozen ACS p25 wage-gap exposure E_p25 (reported per 1-SD and 2-SD spread)
primary_hypotheses.sample: Counties with positive direct-grower (h2a_labor_contractor == 'N') start-year hours in 2020-2025 (2,913 counties, 17,478 county-years, 65.9% of US H-2A hours)
matched_placebos: 2013-2019 pre-2020 direct-grower event study (E_p25 x year, ref=2019, joint CV3J F(6,16))
primary_hypotheses.flagged_phase1_caution: E_p25 correlates with baseline rurality (ln_pop_2010 r=-0.295, farm_emp_share_0810 r=+0.174); mandatory + X_pre x Year FE referee test required.

primary_hypotheses.estimand: Post-Addendum-B (2020-2025) direct-grower differential H-2A certified-hours elasticity per 1-SD E_p25 absorbing all E_p25 x Year trends (1a-PPML cross-region real-AEWR variation only)
matched_placebos: 2013-2019 direct-grower 1a-PPML (+ E_p25 x Year FE) slope on E_p25 * ln_aewr
primary_hypotheses.flagged_phase1_caution: Low effective clusters (G_eff = 7.29); mandatory 17-region LOO influence audit.

adversarial_referee_battery: R4a structural eps_cost translation: raw s_wage_0810 * ln_aewr under C+RY and C+SY (tests whether 2-SD differential MDE translates to structural cost-share elasticity MDE)
R4a 1a-PPML (+ E_dur x Year FE) variance-retention and trend-reliance check
R4a fixed-cost sensitivity F in {1500, 2500, 4000} and linear mean_weeks_0810 standardization
R4a margin decomposition: certified positions vs hours and paired CV3J implied duration (theta_H - theta_N) to detect baseline-duration mean reversion
R4a direct-grower restriction (2013-2025 and 2020-2025) and E_p25 benchmark on the identical 1,615 baseline-H2A county sample
R2a strict pre-Oct-2-2025 regime check: drop calendar start-year 2025 (2020-2024 only) AND test fiscal-year (FY2020-FY2025) vs start-year attribution to detect Oct-Dec 2025 policy spillover
R2a decomposition: Direct-Grower 2020-2025 vs All Employers 2020-2025 vs H-2ALC Only 2020-2025 vs Direct-Grower 2013-2025, plus County + State x Year FE
Both families: WPU01 PPI decoupling (+ E x ln(ppi_2012)) and nominal ln(aewr) sensitivity
Both families: Predetermined controls (+ X_pre x Year FE for ln_pop_2010, farm_emp_share_0810, ln_emp_farm_0810; and + CDL_0810 x Year FE)
Both families: Certified positions and paired CV3J implied duration (theta_H - theta_N)
Both families: Drop top 1% baseline H-2A counties and complete 17-region leave-one-region-out (LOO) influence audit
